cause_quote: The Windows (WSL2) launch added `operatingSystems: catalog.operatingSystems.filter((os) => os !== "windows/wsl2")` when Crabbox was too old or its version could not be verified.
user_saw: On older Crabbox installations or when the version could not be verified, the cloud OS pickers hid provider-advertised macOS and Windows choices without showing how to enable them.
summary: The fix shows unavailable macOS and Windows choices as disabled with instructions to upgrade Crabbox and restart the Gateway, while preserving provisioning checks.
reasoning: I checked the Windows (WSL2) launch diff and its parent-side tests, which showed that Crabbox discovery previously offered only Linux. The launch shipped the silent omission for Windows (WSL2), and the macOS launch in #143463 extended the same filter to every non-Linux target.
